MUMYEONG-SOUL_CORE.title: Soul Core
MUMYEONG-SOUL_CORE.description: The soul of a great figure, received in the underworld's projection room. Playing that figure's cards raises Mastery by 1; Mastery and the acts deepen your bond. Card rewards and shops only offer shared cards and your figure's cards.{Status}
MUMYEONG-SOUL_CORE.flavor: It beats where a stopped heart used to.
MUMYEONG-GUANYU_GREEN_DRAGON_RELIC.title: Green Dragon Crescent Blade
MUMYEONG-GUANYU_GREEN_DRAGON_RELIC.descr: At the start of each combat, gain 8 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
MUMYEONG-GUANYU_GREEN_DRAGON_RELIC.flavo: A crescent blade carved with a green dragon. Heavy.
MUMYEONG-JOAN_BANNER_RELIC.title: Banner of Orléans
MUMYEONG-JOAN_BANNER_RELIC.description: At the start of your turn, gain 2 [gold]Faith[/gold].
MUMYEONG-JOAN_BANNER_RELIC.flavor: It was not lowered, even in the fire.
MUMYEONG-LEONIDAS_SHIELD_RELIC.title: Spartan Shield
MUMYEONG-LEONIDAS_SHIELD_RELIC.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Phalanx[/gold] and 3 [gold]Counter[/gold].
MUMYEONG-LEONIDAS_SHIELD_RELIC.flavor: Come back with it, or on it.
MUMYEONG-GENGHIS_SEAL_RELIC.title: Seal of the Great Khan
MUMYEONG-GENGHIS_SEAL_RELIC.description: Whenever an enemy dies, gain 1 energy and draw 1 card.
MUMYEONG-GENGHIS_SEAL_RELIC.flavor: A seal honoured from one end of the steppe to the other.
MUMYEONG-YI_TURTLE_SHIP_RELIC.title: Turtle Ship
MUMYEONG-YI_TURTLE_SHIP_RELIC.descriptio: At the end of your turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies and gain 5 [gold]Block[/gold].
MUMYEONG-YI_TURTLE_SHIP_RELIC.flavor: The spikes on its back guard the sea.
MUMYEONG-NAPOLEON_CROWN_RELIC.title: Emperor's Crown
MUMYEONG-NAPOLEON_CROWN_RELIC.flavor: A crown placed by one's own hands.
